name: Selective Attention and Attentional Bottleneck
axiom: Attention admits one channel at a time; unattended channels survive only as fragments.
trigger: Two simultaneous requests compete, and the second is missed entirely.

checklist.text: Route interruptions to one channel instead of stacking toasts and modals.
Do not put two demands in the same moment; queue the second.
Keep a missed request recoverable where the person will look for it.

antiPattern.violation: A toast, a modal, and a banner ask for attention at once.
antiPattern.remediation: One request at a time, queued in a place the person can revisit.

parametricParams.caption: ONE CHANNEL PASSES; THE OTHERS ARRIVE WEAKENED
